title: should quick pick a stream from the sidebar
verifies: clicking a sidebar quick pick button selects the stream and loads the field list

title: should show hero state on fresh arrival with no stream selected
verifies: the main content area shows both hero action cards when no stream is selected

title: should open stream dropdown when clicking select stream card
verifies: clicking the "Select a stream" hero card opens the stream dropdown popover

title: should reappear quick pick after deselecting and re-select works
verifies: after deselecting a stream the quick pick reappears and re-selection works correctly

title: should show more footer when org has more than 8 streams
verifies: the quick pick more footer is visible with the correct remaining count when org has > 8 streams (skips otherwise)

title: should select stream via hero recent chip
verifies: clicking a recent-stream chip in the hero state selects the stream and triggers field list loading

title: should open query guide documentation in new tab
verifies: clicking the "Read the query guide" card opens the OpenObserve docs in a new browser tab
